verdict.rationale: Fathom's own API lets users pull their meeting data. It can list meetings, return transcripts and summaries directly, and generate a downloadable recording file delivered via a short-lived signed URL. An admin key can read all shared meetings across teams. This is per-recording API retrieval rather than a documented one-click full-account export, and the evidence never specifies the file formats or describes offboarding. Missing for 10: bulk 'export everything' feature, documented open file formats for exports, coverage of all data types (clips, comments, playlists, scorecards), account deletion/offboarding docs, independent hands-on corroboration.
